out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. OBSERVED THREE-VAT SINK MEET MAXIMUM TEMPERATURE OF 106F DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. PIC PLACED WORK ORDER FOR THREE-VAT SINK DURING INSPECTION AND WILL ENSURE IT CAN MEET 110F AT A MINIMUM BY THE 9TH OF JUNE.
